skip.why: A long hunt for the rare species
A hard manoeuvre, twice, on a timer

parts.title: Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise
parts.lede: The Leonida Keys, almost all as Jason. The chapter ends with the house and your carried cash gone, so everything in Part B has to be done before mission 20.

items.n: Scanning with WAiNK counts. Keep scanning after this: the checklist wants 200.
Keep going after this: the checklist wants 100 animals.

items.t: **Get Shirley's Rum.** Optional, and only exists in Chapter 1.
**Steal the Scooter.** Optional, and only exists in Chapter 1.
**Start Kenton's dives.** He drops off the map for a while and returns between Chapters 2 and 3.
**Start the three games on the home console.** Starting each one counts, and the console is out of reach in Chapter 2.
**Gunslinger:** take down 5 enemies in one use of combat focus.
**If Lucia offers a meditation at home, say yes.** Unconfirmed, but it may count toward Positive Mental Attitude and may not come back.
**Take Donnie's H&L .38** from the trunk before you get rid of his car. It is a unique revolver.

items.n: A use for cash you would otherwise lose in mission 20.

groups.h: Part C: point of no return

items.t: **Manual save in a slot of its own**, before you talk to Lucia on the beach. Keep it.
**Deposit your cash**, ideally at least $5,000 in Family Savings. Anything you carry is lost.

parts.title: Chapter 2: Paradise Lost
parts.lede: Port Gellhorn, with the Starlet Motel as home. You play Lucia until Coffee Break. After it you can switch freely, and most of the side jobs open.

items.t: **Manual save** at the start of the chapter.
**Check Out McKittrick Farm.** Read Kyle's flyer on the wall outside the motel reception to start it. [Kyle's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#kyle).
**On the Spot:** start registering vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need 10.
**Collect Chemicals for Kyle.** He texts about a day after the first job.

items.n: Should arrive on its own around here if you scan and study as you go.

items.t: **Hit Avery Pawn.** Pawn shops count as Smash 'N' Grabs from here.
**Hit Kingpin Bowling.** Take all three valuables; a hidden trophy depends on it.
**Impounded Vehicle.**
**Veteran Hunted.** Jason only, and go alone. Opens Bret's hunts and his Target Decks. [Bret](/guides/side-contacts/#bret).

items.n: You keep the Sanchez from Billy's job.

groups.h: With your partner, in one session

items.t: **Retail Therapy:** rob 3 shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop.

items.n: The same run as Retail Therapy.

items.t: **Hot Together:** get away from four stars together.

items.n: The same chase as Hot Together.

items.t: **Manual save in a slot of its own.** It is your way back to Chapter 2 free roam.
**Have at least $15,000 in BuckMe.** The mission won't start without it.
**Finish what you want to do from the Starlet Motel.** It stops being your home.

parts.title: Chapter 3: Tits Ass Drug Money
parts.lede: Vice City opens, and with it Pay 'n' Spray, jewelry stores, bank jobs and most of the fences.

items.t: **Manual save** at the start of the chapter.
**The home console works again.** Start the games now if you missed them.
**Kenton is back.** Carry on diving.
**Join a Street Race.** Jason only, in Salton. [Yago's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#yago).
**Bumper to Bumper.** Yago's shop in Little Cuba.
**Race Against Yago.** Limited time: do it the moment the hourglass shows up.
**Brother to Brother.** The strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
**Say yes to Halifax.** Turning him down can cost you the later parts of the job and their rewards once the chapter ends. [Story choices](/guides/story-choices/).
**Yasmani, first store: Casa de Empeno.** Hand the piece in straight away to get the Snap Gun. [Yasmani's jobs](/guides/side-contacts/#yasmani).
**Yasmani, the other two stores**, through the back door with the Snap Gun.
**Sneakthief:** rob a jewelry store without being detected. The back-door stores are the place to try.
**Bank jobs and payday loans are open**, and marked bills can be fenced. [Fences](/guides/fences/).
**A Classic Blitz Play:** rob an armored truck and get away.
**Buddy?** Kyle's last text comes around the middle of the chapter. His strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

items.n: The key cloner opens locked high-end cars.

items.t: **Little Boxes:** start buying the garage properties.
**Treat Yo Self:** all of this spending counts toward the $100,000.
**Manual save in a slot of its own.**

parts.title: Chapter 4: Vice City, Baby
parts.lede: Two optional missions matter here: one opens the vaults, the other is limited-time. We don't yet know between which missions they appear, so watch for them from the start.

items.t: **Manual save** at the start of the chapter.
**This Is a Free Call From…** Optional, Lucia only and limited-time. Take it straight away.
**That's Where The Money Is…** Optional. Opens the eight large bank vaults.
**Maximum Withdrawal:** rob 5 vaults. The checklist wants all 8.
**Attend Eddie Acosta's Party.** He texts a few days after you meet him. Go alone. [Eddie](/guides/side-contacts/#eddie).
**Manual save in a slot of its own**, with the preparation missions done.
**Manual save** at the end of the chapter.

parts.title: Chapter 5: Top of the World, Ma
parts.lede: Seven missions in a row. Their names give the ending away, so they are numbers only here; the names are behind the spoiler block on the walkthrough page.

items.t: **Manual save in a slot of its own** before the last mission. There is no replay.
**Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion** and see what is left.

parts.title: Free roam
parts.lede: Six blocks, in this order. The number at the end of a line is what the 100% checklist asks for.

items.t: **Bank jobs.**
**Vaults.**
**Payday loans.**
**Smash 'N' Grabs.**
**Stick ups.**
**Fence totals:** narcotics $100,000, jewelry $100,000, marked bills $250,000, vehicles $200,000.

items.n: Half of the vehicle total in one go.

groups.h: B: one region at a time

items.t: **Gang operations.** One from each of the nine gangs earns Pest Control.
**Cocaine Flamingos.**
**Stunts.** Cunning Stunts unlocks at 250.
**Basketball hoops.**
**Drone time trials.** Winning at all 14 locations earns Top Fun.
**WAiNK locations.** Also earns You WAiNKer!
**Meditation spots**, with both Jason and Lucia. Positive Mental Attitude needs all 18.
**Collectible Card sets.** Don't Touch My Deck unlocks at 3.
**Underwater discoveries.**
**Kenton sets**, and his last mission for a hidden trophy.
**Magazines, books and comics.**
**Styles**, and the two playlists.
**The Goodtime State:** uncover the whole map.
**Shooting range golds.** Also earns The Shootist.
**Unique races won.** Earn Cash, Not Kudos unlocks at 20.
**Race challenge golds.**

items.n: Covers the two mini golf locations the checklist wants.

items.t: **Pool opponents.**
**Baited My Tackle:** beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
**Bret's Target Decks**, as Jason.
**Standard issue weapons.**
**Little Boxes, On the Spot and Treat Yo Self:** finish all three.
**Billy:** Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes and whatever follows.
**Randy, Tyrone, Kenton and Bret:** finish each strand. [Side contacts](/guides/side-contacts/).
**Strangers & Freaks:** 8 strands. Not every contact counts, so check the trophy tracker after each last job.
**Master of None:** try each type of activity once.
**Stick Fiddler:** complete one arcade game.
**Challenging Tank** and the other one-off trophies. [Trophy list](/trophies/).
**Base model vehicles scanned**, and 100 animals studied.
**Challenges.** One Last Thing unlocks at 50.
**A Long Road:** 100% completion.
